
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/aqi00/p/22126320" title="发布于 2026-08-01 11:37">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15天学会AI应用开发（十八）使用LangGraph实现精确记忆功能</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span>上一篇文章介绍了如何使用LangGraph实现会话记忆功能，可是历史会话又多又杂，难以全部记忆，开发者更希望AI应用记住关键信息，比如用户喜欢什么、爱好什么等等。
<p>对于AI应用的精确记忆需求，LangChain支持在调用create_agent时输入store参数，以指定数据存储方式，接下来介绍如何通过store参数存取用户的偏好信息。</p>
<h1>一、创建智能体实例时的输入参数</h1>
<p>上一篇文章调用create_agent时，仅用到了少数几个参数，为方便后续的函数引用，下面逐一说明create_agent的常见输入参数：</p>
<p>model：智能体推理所需的大模型实例。<br>
tools：智能体可调用的工具集合，如计算器、搜索、数据库等。<br>
system_prompt：智能体的提示词信息，可规定智能体的特定行为。<br>
middleware：给智能体的执行链路挂载全局拦截处理器，在大模型调用、工具执行、消息流转的前后统一做切面处理，无需修改智能体的主要逻辑。可用于压缩历史记录、统一打印日志、过滤输入输出、限制请求流量、异常统一捕获等等。<br>
context_schema：智能体会话的上下文信息，包括用户ID、租户信息、数据库连接、访问权限等等。<br>
checkpointer：智能体的状态快照持久化管理器，可开启会话记忆、断点续跑、状态存档能力。不传该参数则智能体完全无状态，每轮调用后会清空所有历史对话与工具执行记录。<br>
store：智能体的数据存储器，可长期记忆用户的业务数据。为InMemoryStore实例时，表示数据保存在内存中；为SqliteStore实例时，表示数据保存在Sqlite。<br>
debug：是否打印调试日志。</p>
<h1>二、存储工具Store的常见用法</h1>
<p>不管InMemoryStore还是SqliteStore，都基于BaseStore，且拥有统一的存取方法，说明如下：</p>
<p>put：往指定键名存入对应的键值。<br>
get：从指定键名获取对应的键值。<br>
delete：删除指定键名及其对应的键值。<br>
search：按照指定条件搜索对应的键名及其键值。</p>
<p>比如下面的代码就定义了存取用户偏好的两个工具方法：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="8" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20dataclasses%20import%20dataclass%5Cnfrom%20langchain.tools%20import%20tool%2C%20ToolRuntime%5Cn%5Cn%40dataclass%5Cnclass%20Context%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20user_id%3A%20str%5Cn%5Cn%40tool%5Cndef%20remember_user_preference(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20key%3A%20str%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20value%3A%20str%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20runtime%3A%20ToolRuntime%5BContext%5D%5Cn)%20-%3E%20str%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%E8%AE%B0%E4%BD%8F%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E7%9A%84%E5%81%8F%E5%A5%BD%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20user_id%20%3D%20runtime.context.user_id%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E5%86%99%E5%85%A5%20Store%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20runtime.store.put(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20(%5C%22users%5C%22%2Cuser_id)%2C%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20namespace%EF%BC%8C%E5%90%8D%E5%AD%97%E7%A9%BA%E9%97%B4%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20user_id%2C%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%23%20key%EF%BC%8C%E9%94%AE%E5%90%8D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7B%5C%22preferences%5C%22%3A%20%7Bkey%3A%20value%7D%7D%20%C2%A0%23%20value%EF%BC%8C%E9%94%AE%E5%80%BC%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20f%5C%22%E5%B7%B2%E8%AE%B0%E4%BD%8F%EF%BC%9A%7Bkey%7D%20%3D%20%7Bvalue%7D%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%40tool%5Cndef%20get_user_preference(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20key%3A%20str%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20runtime%3A%20ToolRuntime%5BContext%5D%5Cn)%20-%3E%20str%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E7%9A%84%E5%81%8F%E5%A5%BD%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20user_id%20%3D%20runtime.context.user_id%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E4%BB%8E%20Store%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20item%20%3D%20runtime.store.get((%5C%22users%5C%22%2Cuser_id)%2C%20user_id)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20item%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20prefs%20%3D%20item.value.get(%5C%22preferences%5C%22%2C%20%7B%7D)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20prefs.get(key%2C%20%5C%22%E6%9C%AA%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20%5C%22%E6%9C%AA%E6%89%BE%E5%88%B0%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%5C%22%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from dataclasses import dataclass
from langchain.tools import tool, ToolRuntime

@dataclass
class Context:
&nbsp; &nbsp; user_id: str

@tool
def remember_user_preference(
&nbsp; &nbsp; key: str,
&nbsp; &nbsp; value: str,
&nbsp; &nbsp; runtime: ToolRuntime[Context]
) -&gt; str:
&nbsp; &nbsp; """记住用户的偏好设置"""
&nbsp; &nbsp; user_id = runtime.context.user_id

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 写入 Store
&nbsp; &nbsp; runtime.store.put(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ("users",user_id), &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # namespace，名字空间
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; user_id, &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# key，键名
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {"preferences": {key: value}} &nbsp;# value，键值
&nbsp; &nbsp; )
&nbsp; &nbsp; return f"已记住：{key} = {value}"

@tool
def get_user_preference(
&nbsp; &nbsp; key: str,
&nbsp; &nbsp; runtime: ToolRuntime[Context]
) -&gt; str:
&nbsp; &nbsp; """获取用户的偏好设置"""
&nbsp; &nbsp; user_id = runtime.context.user_id

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 从 Store 读取
&nbsp; &nbsp; item = runtime.store.get(("users",user_id), user_id)
&nbsp; &nbsp; if item:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; prefs = item.value.get("preferences", {})
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return prefs.get(key, "未设置")
&nbsp; &nbsp; return "未找到用户信息"</code></pre>
</div>
<h1>三、使用InMemoryStore记住用户偏好</h1>
<p>在命令行窗口执行下面命令，即可安装LangChain及其用到的Ollama插件，以及记忆功能需要的LangGraph：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="7" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20langchain%20langchain-core%20langchain-ollama%20langgraph%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install langchain langchain-core langchain-ollama langgraph</code></pre>
</div>
<p>由于之前使用的离线大模型Qwen2:1.5B不支持tool工具调用，因此得下载支持tool工具调用的离线大模型Qwen2.5:3B，也就是在命令行窗口执行下面命令，即可下载大模型qwen2.5:3b：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22ollama%20pull%20qwen2.5%3A3b%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">ollama pull qwen2.5:3b</code></pre>
</div>
<p>等待大模型下载完毕，在命令行窗口执行下面命令，即可启动Ollama并加载大模型：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22ollama%20serve%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">ollama serve</code></pre>
</div>
<p>在Python代码开头添加下面的导包语句，表示引入LangChain的智能体组件create_agent、人类消息组件HumanMessage、LangChain的大模型工具OllamaLLM，以及LangGraph的内存存储组件InMemoryStore：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20langchain.agents%20import%20create_agent%5Cnfrom%20langchain.messages%20import%20HumanMessage%5Cnfrom%20langchain_ollama%20import%20ChatOllama%5Cnfrom%20langgraph.store.memory%20import%20InMemoryStore%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain.messages import HumanMessage
from langchain_ollama import ChatOllama
from langgraph.store.memory import InMemoryStore</code></pre>
</div>
<p>在OllamaLLM的构造方法中填写model参数，指定当前引用的离线大模型名称，如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22llm%20%3D%20ChatOllama(model%3D%5C%22qwen2.5%3A3b%5C%22)%20%C2%A0%23%20%E6%94%B9%E6%88%90%E4%BD%A0%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E7%9A%84%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">llm = ChatOllama(model="qwen2.5:3b") &nbsp;# 改成你本地的模型</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写下面的LangChain调用代码，先调用create_agent创建支持内存存取的智能体实例，再通过智能体实例的invoke实例调用离线大模型，示例代码如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E6%8F%90%E5%88%B0%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%B8%9C%E8%A5%BF%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E4%BC%9A%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8remember_user_preference%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%EF%BC%9B%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E8%AF%A2%E9%97%AE%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%B8%9C%E8%A5%BF%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E4%BC%9A%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8get_user_preference%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E3%80%82%5Cnagent%20%3D%20create_agent(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20model%3Dllm%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20context_schema%3DContext%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20tools%3D%5Bremember_user_preference%2C%20get_user_preference%5D%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20system_prompt%3D%5C%22%E5%BD%93%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E6%8F%90%E5%88%B0%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%B8%9C%E8%A5%BF%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E8%AF%B7%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8remember_user_preference%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%EF%BC%9B%E5%BD%93%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E8%AF%A2%E9%97%AE%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%B8%9C%E8%A5%BF%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E8%AF%B7%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8get_user_preference%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E3%80%82%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20store%3DInMemoryStore()%5Cn)%5Cn%5Cnwhile%20True%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20user_input%20%3D%20input(%5C%22%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%EF%BC%9A%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20user_input%20in%20%5B%5C%22%E9%80%80%E5%87%BA%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22exit%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22quit%5C%22%5D%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%E7%BB%93%E6%9D%9F%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20break%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20result%20%3D%20agent.invoke(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7B%5C%22messages%5C%22%3A%20%5BHumanMessage(content%3Duser_input)%5D%7D%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20context%3DContext(user_id%3D%5C%22user_123%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(f%5C%22AI%EF%BC%9A%7Bresult%5B'messages'%5D%5B-1%5D.content%7D%5C%5Cn%5C%22)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs"># 用户提到喜欢什么东西时，会调用remember_user_preference工具；用户询问喜欢什么东西时，会调用get_user_preference工具。
agent = create_agent(
&nbsp; &nbsp; model=llm,
&nbsp; &nbsp; context_schema=Context,
&nbsp; &nbsp; tools=[remember_user_preference, get_user_preference],
&nbsp; &nbsp; system_prompt="当用户提到喜欢什么东西时，请调用remember_user_preference工具；当用户询问喜欢什么东西时，请调用get_user_preference工具。",
&nbsp; &nbsp; store=InMemoryStore()
)

while True:
&nbsp; &nbsp; user_input = input("用户：")
&nbsp; &nbsp; if user_input in ["退出", "exit", "quit"]:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print("对话结束")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; break

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 调用离线大模型
&nbsp; &nbsp; result = agent.invoke(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {"messages": [HumanMessage(content=user_input)]},
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; context=Context(user_id="user_123")
&nbsp; &nbsp; )
&nbsp; &nbsp; print(f"AI：{result['messages'][-1].content}\n")</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，根据提示先后输入问题内容“我喜欢绿色”、“我喜欢什么颜色？”，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%EF%BC%9A%E6%88%91%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E7%BB%BF%E8%89%B2%5CnAI%EF%BC%9A%E4%BD%A0%E7%9A%84%E6%9C%80%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E7%9A%84%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%E6%98%AF%E7%BB%BF%E8%89%B2%E3%80%82%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E4%BD%A0%E6%9C%89%E5%85%B6%E4%BB%96%E5%81%8F%E5%A5%BD%E6%83%B3%E8%A6%81%E8%AE%B0%E4%BD%8F%EF%BC%8C%E9%9A%8F%E6%97%B6%E5%91%8A%E8%AF%89%E6%88%91%E5%93%A6%EF%BC%81%5Cn%5Cn%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%EF%BC%9A%E6%88%91%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%EF%BC%9F%5CnAI%EF%BC%9A%E4%BD%A0%E7%9A%84%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E7%9A%84%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%E6%98%AF%E7%BB%BF%E8%89%B2%E3%80%82%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E4%BD%A0%E6%9C%89%E4%BB%BB%E4%BD%95%E5%85%B6%E4%BB%96%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%96%E8%80%85%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E5%B8%AE%E5%8A%A9%EF%BC%8C%E8%AF%B7%E5%91%8A%E8%AF%89%E6%88%91%EF%BC%81%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">用户：我喜欢绿色
AI：你的最喜欢的颜色是绿色。如果你有其他偏好想要记住，随时告诉我哦！

用户：我喜欢什么颜色？
AI：你的喜欢的颜色是绿色。如果你有任何其他问题，或者需要帮助，请告诉我！</code></pre>
</div>
<p>由日志信息发现，AI应用在第一个问答中得知用户喜欢绿色，在第二个问答中正确回忆起用户的偏好颜色。可见通过LangGraph的内存存储组件InMemoryStore，初步实现了用户偏好的精确记忆功能。</p>
<p>本系列的AI应用开发文章目录为《<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="0" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">15天学会AI应用开发全目录（零基础小白，零Token消耗）》。</span>​</p>
